0.original: Charlys would have you reaffirm your desire to join the Culinarians' Guild.

1.original: You have been referred to Lyngsath, the master of the Culinarians' Guild. Seek him out and impress upon him your desire to learn.

2.original: Having welcomed you into the guild, Lyngsath presents you with a weathered skillet to help you on your way. Take up the tool of your new trade, and speak with the guildmaster again to be assigned your first task.

48.original: So, have you the resolve to walk the path of the culinarian?

49.original: Wonderful! Then you must speak to Guildmaster Lyngsath at once!

50.original: This will come as no surprise, but he is the finest chef in Limsa Lominsa. His skill and dedication are second to none.

51.original: You will find the guildmaster up the stairs yonder, keeping a watchful eye on his charges. Impress upon him your desire to learn, and he will surely find a place for you in his stew─by which I mean the guild.

52.original: Still unsure? Then I think it best that you do not go before the guildmaster.

53.original: As I believe I mentioned, he is passionate about cookery, and has little patience for those who show anything less than absolute commitment to the craft. Such ingredients spoil the stew, you see...and he is <hex:021A020203>fiercely<hex:021A020103> protective of his stew.

54.original: Well met, 'venturer. I take it ye want to join our guild. Let's 'ave a good look at ye, then.

55.original: ...Bah! What's an underfed whelp like you know about cookin'? Judgin' by them scrawny arms o' yours, ye'd struggle to lift a spoon, never mind a skillet!

56.original: ...Hahaha! I jest, I jest... <sigh> It don't take muscle to be a culinarian. 'Ells, it don't even take talent─'least not on its own.

57.original: No, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF04736F6E03>, more'n anythin' else, becomin' a good cook boils down to <hex:021A020203>passion<hex:021A020103>. If ye got that, there ain't nothin' ye can't achieve. So tell me...'ave ye got it?

58.original: Have you the passion to become a culinarian?

61.original: Well, then...assumin' you ain't got an overwhelmin' urge to scrub me pans neither, I suggest ye bugger off back to where the food's served, an' leave the makin' of it to folks as give a damn.

62.original: That's the spirit! Aye, yer passion fer the culinary arts is plain to see.

63.original: An' ye'll be needin' every bit of it if ye want to become a master culinarian. Why, if mastery was a twelve-course dinner, I'd 'ardly 'ave finished the soup.

64.original: Make no mistake, our trade's as tough as old mutton, an' passion's the only thing what gets us through the gristly bits. But enough talk─what do ye call yerself?

65.original: Well then, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, welcome to the guild. To mark the occasion, I present ye with yer very own skillet.

66.original: Ain't much to look at, but it'll more'n serve a novice like yerself.

67.original: Now then, let's see whether ye can tell which end's which. Aye, aye...I know I said ye'd struggle to lift a spoon, but ye've won me over. Now, show me ye <hex:021A020203>can<hex:021A020103> 'old a skillet, an' I'll get ye started on yer first task.

68.original: You have unlocked a new class! You can change to this class at any time by equipping the tool received from this quest.

69.original: When changing classes, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>gear sets<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will allow you to register and save your equipment. You may then use them to switch between classes instantly without the need to manually equip weapons or equipment.

70.original: A button for the Gear Set interface is located in the upper portion of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Character<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> window.
